title: Card in a jacket pocket
slide_intent: Make a financial product feel usable in daily life because familiarity depends on seeing it in human situations.
strategic_value: The bright green card against a blue jacket can make Wise recognizable without a headline.
demonstration: A hand slips a green Wise card into a blue jacket pocket; the crop concentrates attention on the card and fabric.
practical_value: Choose a close crop when the product color and handling gesture can carry the message.

content_islands.name: Card and hand
content_islands.spec: Keep the tilted green card visible between fingers above the pocket.

content_islands.name: Clothing context
content_islands.spec: Surround the product with blue fabric and a small strip of striped shirt.
